description: This file defines the NotInBinary class, which extends AbstractBinary, for handling the 'not in' binary operator in Twig templates. It contains methods to compile this operator and specify its operator string.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\Binary\NotInBinary
classes.description: Represents the 'not in' binary operator in Twig's expression syntax, providing compilation logic.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the 'not in' operation, invoking the inFilter method and passing the left and right nodes.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the operator, 'not in'.
